scan.summary: This is the state cannabis production license itself — the OLCC's own document authorizing Evergreen Botanicals, LLC to grow marijuana at 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, as a Tier II indoor producer with a 10,000 sq ft mature canopy limit. Because it is the agency's document, there is nothing in it for the company to correct; what matters is renewing it on time, keeping to the five conditions printed on it, and keeping it posted where the public can see it at the premises. The current term runs March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027, and the renewal application and fee must be in OLCC's hands by roughly February 10, 2027.
scan.freshness_note: This is the current term's license, issued 2026-03-03 and valid to 2027-03-02, so it is the live copy today (2026-09-27). It will need replacing with the next term's license after the 2027 renewal. Note that the wall-posted copy must be this one, not a prior term's.

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence on everything read off the face of the license — licensee, premises, license number, type, canopy limit, term dates, and the five conditions are all printed on page 1 and quoted word for word. High confidence that this is a current, unexpired license as of 2026-09-27. The 2027-02-10 renewal date is inferred arithmetic from the license's own '20 days before the expiration date' wording; OLCC's published guidance and OAR 845-025-1190 / 845-025-1070 align with a 20-day filing point (late fees apply inside it), but confirm the exact date in CAMP rather than relying on my count. The Tier II indoor band of 5,001–10,000 sq ft matches OAR 845-025-2040(3)(a), so the 10,000 sq ft figure on the license is consistent with the rule. I am not sure of the current status of the Measure 119 labor peace agreement requirement — it has been the subject of litigation and OLCC bulletins, so treat that item as something to verify with OLCC before the next renewal, not as a settled requirement. I have not judged this document for gaps, because it is the agency's own instrument.

OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
